YouTube Payment System Thresholds: https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/1709871 YouTube Monetisation Eligible Countries: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/1342206 I'm Greg Preece, a YouTuber based out of the United Kingdom. asr.full_text: YouTube recently celebrated its 15th birthday and chances are if you're alive today, you've watched a video on the website and it's been my feeling that over the last few years more and more people were having the idea of creating their own YouTube channel. The videos on my YouTube channel that teach people how to start and how to get paid on YouTube are currently booming and with everyone stuck inside at the moment learning about the ways that they can make money from home, YouTube has gone fully mainstream. So this video is gonna teach you how to get paid on YouTube after you've started your brand new YouTube channel. And with the world changing so quickly at the moment and people wanting this information as fast as possible, I'm gonna teach you everything you need to know in the next three minutes, maybe four if I get carried away. So once you've started your new YouTube channel channel you're gonna have to hit two benchmarks. You're gonna have to get 1,000 people to subscribe to your new channel, and on top of that you're gonna have to get 4,000 hours worth of time of your videos watched in a 12 month period. After you hit these two benchmarks YouTube's gonna ask you to enter your payment information information so that it knows how to pay you once everything is set up. Your channel was then going to get reviewed from YouTube and if everything goes well, within the next 30 days, you'll receive an email from YouTube telling you that your channel has been activated and can now receive payments. The biggest single tip I can give you right now on how to get those four thousand hours of watch time in 12 months and also to get your 1000 subscribers in total is consistency consistency is key make sure you're talking about a consistent topic on your channel over an extended period of time so people know what your channel is about and also you should be uploading your videos and publishing them at a similar time and each time so the same day of the week, preferably even the same time. People need to know when to expect new videos from you. I can't give you all of the tips I have on how to get those subscribers and get that watch time in this short video but if you want more information you can find out everything you need to know in this longer video which I will link you to below in the description. Once you've been approved your channel is going to have to collect its $100 in total from the adverts shown on your videos before you get your first payment. In general, YouTube pays you around $2 for every thousand views you get, so that means you'll need to get around 50,000 views to get your first $100 to get your first payment. Now, that your first payment now that one hundred dollars is a threshold that you're going to have to hit before youtube will consider paying you any future payments but the more videos you upload to your channel over time and the more views you're getting regularly means you're going to be hitting that threshold quicker and quicker every time and you'll get to a point where you're getting paid from YouTube on a monthly basis because you're passing that threshold every month. Depending on what country you live in the currency target changes, I'll send you a link to this website you'll see on screen now so you can see exactly how much you have to earn each time for the country that you live in. And YouTube pays you some time between the 21st and the 26th of every month. But unfortunately, YouTube only pays creators that live in certain countries. You'll see some of those countries onscreen now and I'll link you in the description below to the article where you can see the full list of supported countries for YouTube payments. If you live outside of these countries, then unfortunately you're not gonna be able to make any money on YouTube. So that's all you need to get paid on YouTube. You pass the criteria of 1,000 subscribers and 4,000 hours of watch time in a 12-month period. You will then get approved in that 30-day approval period and once you hit that $100 threshold you will then get paid between the 21st and the 26th of every month. So thanks for watching everyone comment below if you've got any more questions or any more tips for people watching this video, and subscribe to the channel and make sure to watch future videos, I'm always giving YouTube tips, online video tips, entrepreneurship tips on here every week on a Monday trying to help you succeed online just like I did. Thanks for watching, I'll see you soon, peace out.
